Services

What the shop does

The shop's trade, in its own words: high quality cuts. The gallery above is the evidence — fades, tapers, and long hair alike.

Tapers are on the shop's published offerings, and its own photos are full of them — back views and side views, finished clean.

It's in the name — Barbershop & Shave Parlor — and straight razor shaves are on the published offerings. The razor sits at the center of the shop's logo for a reason.

The shop's own lockup says it plainly: “Work done by appointment.” Call or message ahead and get in the book.
